positions.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
●​ Served as the frontend technical lead on a 7-person engineering team for Blackbird, a new SaaS API development platform for developers, guiding the client app architecture and implementation to deliver a fast, reliable, and intuitive experience.

●​ Partnered with Product from day one to shape both the functionality and interface, iterating quickly on flows and layouts with low-fidelity mocks and Figma, and folding in real usage feedback to guide the final UX and frontend architecture.

●​ Integrated AI/LLM powered workflows directly into Blackbird, including a chatbot that helped users generate and refine OpenAPI specs and a codebase analyzer that generated specs from existing services. Significantly reducing the time it takes teams to get to a usable API definition.

●​ Set up the frontend testing approach using Playwright for end-to-end coverage and Jest for unit tests, and introduced standards that made releases more predictable and less stressful.

●​ Provided technical guidance through code reviews, pairing, and shared patterns, helping align the team on frontend best practices and consistent code quality.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
●​ Senior Frontend Engineer in a 30+ person product and engineering organization, working on the Stoplight platform across both the administration and Studio applications. Modernizing the core admin platform and helping build complex data-heavy interfaces for our API design and collaboration tool.

●​ Worked closely with product and designers to turn high-fidelity Figma designs into robust, composable React components, and picked up backend work when needed so features were fully supported from the UI through to the APIs.

●​ Served as the main maintainer of the Mosaic design system, shaping and evolving the component library and guidelines that multiple product teams relied on for a consistent, predictable UI.

●​ Improved frontend developer experience by creating a shared component repository and rolling out Chomatic, making it easier to discover, reuse, and test components and encouraging consistent patterns across teams.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Node.js · Tailwind CSS · Front-end development · Figma (Software) · PgSQL · Open API

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Frontend
positions.description:
●​ Helped with a major migration of a client-side SaaS platform from Ext JS to modern React and Redux, keeping both codebases running smoothly while we moved features over and continued shipping.

●​ Worked on complex ecommerce flows and admin tools, balancing performance, reliability, and configurability for large retail clients.

●​ Acted as a go-to frontend engineer for the distributed UI platform team, mentoring teammates through code reviews and pairing and helping keep the overall quality bar high.

●​ Worked with product and engineering leads to balance quick feature delivery with long term health of the codebase, weighing in during sprint planning and reviews to keep solutions pragmatic and maintainable.

●​ Maintained and extended the core storefront theme and JavaScript SDK, tying together Backbone.js, ASP.NET, and Django to meet the needs of complex retail clients.

positions.title: Web Communications Specialist
positions.description: SharePoint 2013 & Front-end developer responsible for internal admin departments SP 2007 to 2013 update. Working closely with departments to assess and restructure resources, train users on SP 2013, design SP solutions to meet agency needs, and development of custom SP modules and solutions for all internal and external SP sites. I was also largely involved with providing front-end development support for several internal agency applications. Helping provide a focused direction for the look, feel, and integration of our applications through .Net UI development, REST API design and development, and integrated branding solutions.

projects.title: Centex New Media
projects.description:
Centex New Media is a locally-organized, new media “un-conference” and community covering anything related to new media. 


The first Centex New Media Conference will be held March 2, 2013, at the Texas Farm Bureau headquarters in Waco. The conference will attract about 100 of the saviest new media enthusiasts and professionals including marketers, developers, designers, bloggers and creative professionals in and around Central Texas within the new media community
